summary: Phase-5 auth/account + Advanced Address Management (1.2) tested end-to-end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_phase5_auth_address.py (22 new tests) covering forgot/reset-password OTP, guest checkout, address CRUD (full advanced payload), serviceability + admin pincode gating, account deletion + admin approve/reject endpoints, and auth/config exposure. All 22 pass; full regression of pre-existing suites also green (174/174) => 196/196 backend. Frontend: verified with Playwright on the public preview URL — (1) Forgot-password dialog: dev OTP toast + auto-fill, reset succeeds, login with NEW password works; (2) Guest checkout while logged out: 'Continue as Guest' reveals guest-name/guest-phone + full AddressForm, serviceability banner shows, POST /bookings/guest succeeds (AZO87798) and the same phone can OTP-login and see the booking; (3) Address book: add with all advanced fields (label chips, property type, wing/floor/flat, landmark, instructions, pet toggle+pet fields, parking/lift switches, set-default), edit, set-default (exactly one Default badge), delete — all work; (4) Booking with saved-address chips: saved chip hides inline form, 'New' shows AddressForm, normal booking confirmed (count 91->92); (5) Account deletion: danger zone -> dialog -> 'Deletion requested. An admin will review' toast, user NOT logged out; admin 'Account Deletions' shows the pending row and Reject restores the account (rejected, request removed from actionable list); (6) Admin 'Address Settings': all toggles + property types + serviceable pincodes save; with 800001 configured, 999999 shows 'Sorry, we don't deliver to this location yet' and confirm-booking is blocked, 800001 is accepted. Cleanup done: serviceable_pincodes emptied (verified /api/geo/serviceability?pincode=999999 -> serviceable:true, reason no_pincodes_configured), deletion request rejected (demo customer intact), test address deleted, address_config toggles restored.

minor.issue: No rate limiting / attempt counter. An attacker can spam OTP generation for a known identifier and brute-force the 6-digit OTP within the 10-minute window (unlimited reset-password attempts). Recommend max 5 wrong attempts -> invalidate record, and throttle forgot-password per identifier/IP.
Response always returns "created": false even when a brand-new account is created (misleading field for clients).

Full-document replace: fields absent from the payload are silently dropped, and if the payload sets is_default=false for the only default address the user ends up with zero default addresses (add/delete paths self-heal, update does not).

Guest-created user keeps is_guest:true forever; after the guest later logs in via OTP the flag is never cleared, so downstream logic that treats guests differently will misclassify a real registered customer.

issues: React console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription for a11y (repeats on every dialog open).

action_items: Add throttling + wrong-attempt limit to forgot-password/reset-password OTP flow.
Clear is_guest when a guest-created user completes a real OTP login.
Make PUT /api/auth/address merge instead of replace, and guarantee exactly one default address after update.
Fix misleading "created": false in POST /api/auth/email response.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to DialogContent to remove the a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_controller._hash_pw uses a hand-rolled PBKDF2-SHA256(100k) salted hash. Functionally correct and salted, but it deviates from the bcrypt ($2b$) convention in the auth playbook; if bcrypt is expected for parity with other Emergent apps, migrate with a hash-format-aware verifier. No httpOnly cookie session either — JWT is stored in localStorage (XSS-exposed) and there is no brute-force lockout on email login; those playbook checks (bcrypt format, httpOnly cookie, lockout, seed_admin password update) simply do not exist in this custom OTP-first design and should be confirmed as intentional.
geo_service.check_serviceable is called on every keystroke-blur from the client and re-reads settings; fine now, but consider caching settings to avoid a Mongo read per pincode check.
GET /api/auth/config correctly withholds serviceable_pincodes and all secret keys — verified by test.
frontend/src/pages/admin/adminSections.jsx is 654 lines and holds many unrelated admin sections; it is approaching the 700-line split threshold.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New suite: /app/backend/tests/test_phase5_auth_address.py — run it with `-n 0` because TestServiceability and TestAdminAddressConfig both mutate settings.address_config and would race under the pytest.ini default `-n 2 --dist loadscope`. rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The main agent's inability to visually confirm the guest-mode toggle was a screenshot-tool re-navigation artifact, not an app bug: clicking continue-guest-btn reliably renders guest-name, guest-phone and the AddressForm (verified in-session before any re-navigation).
